entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, are you busy today too?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's a shame if you are.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I could've taught you[n]something good if you[n]came back to the store.
entries.uk: Я міг би навчити тебе[n]чогось путнього, якби ти[n]повернувся в кафе.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well, the choice is yours.[n]Do what you want.
entries.uk: Ну, вибір за тобою.[n]Роби як знаєш.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Something happen to you? Don't[n]be afraid to come back, OK?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Great choice. Come right home[n]then. I'll be waiting for you.
entries.uk: Чудовий вибір. Тоді йди[n]одразу додому. Чекаю на тебе.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What are you going to do? Will you[n]accept the chief's invitation?
